name: Meta-embeddings Benchmark
description: In the last few years, several methods have been proposed to build meta-embeddings. The general aim was to obtain new representations integrating complementary knowledge from different source pre-trained embeddings thereby improving their overall quality. However, previous meta-embeddings have been evaluated using a variety of methods and datasets, which makes it difficult to draw meaningful conclusions regarding the merits of each approach. In this paper we propose a unified common framework, including both intrinsic and extrinsic tasks, for a fair and objective meta-embeddings evaluation. Furthermore, we present a new method to generate meta-embeddings, outperforming previous work on a large number of intrinsic evaluation benchmarks. Our evaluation framework also allows us to conclude that previous extrinsic evaluations of meta-embeddings have been overestimated.
typical_sota_score: varies by task and dataset; no single unified SOTA range
reputation: Well-regarded within the word-embedding and representation learning community as a unified evaluation framework for meta-embeddings, but not a mainstream general-NLP benchmark.
notes: Combines many intrinsic and extrinsic tasks; comparisons can be confounded by choice of downstream task and hyperparameters; intrinsic metrics (Spearman) do not always translate to extrinsic gains; not an LLM benchmark.
